dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge following a falcate spline that curves inward from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification and a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree inclination of the anterior margin relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc forming a continuous curve from the dorsal blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak protruding anteriorly with a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle clearly visible at the pixel junction where the melon arc terminates and the rostrum surface begins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of circular, high-value (pale) spots on the anterior-lateral flank, potentially representing healed lesions or distinct markings.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity cyan and white luminescent regions located along the dorsal ridge and mid-lateral flank, creating extreme contrast against the dark ventral and posterior areas.
